children.title: Migrate a Classic Layer
children.description: Translate a FeatureLayer styled on its ZoomLevelSet and add it to a MapStyle, beside the classic renderer drawing the same layers

children.title: Frequently Asked Questions
children.description: Frequently asked questions about the samples and the SDK

children.title: Vector Map Providers
children.description: ThinkGeo Maps (light, dark), OpenFreeMap's free keyless styles, the keyed providers - Mapbox, Esri, TomTom and more - as a page of their style URLs, and any MVT server by the URL of its style document

children.title: WFS
children.description: Merge a WFS V2 service into the basemap style - Dutch cadastral parcels from PDOK, numbered from their own attributes

children.title: OGC API Feature Server
children.description: Merge an OGC API Features collection into the basemap style, labeled from its own attributes

children.title: NOAA Weather Stations
children.description: NOAA weather stations' current readings - dots colored by temperature, labeled from the data

children.title: NOAA Weather Warnings
children.description: NOAA weather warnings merged into the basemap style - polygons colored by severity, labeled by event

children.title: Raster Map Providers
children.description: ThinkGeo Cloud (light, dark, aerial, hybrid) and OpenStreetMap as one tile source each, and the keyed providers - Azure Maps, Google Maps, HERE and Mapbox - as a page of their classes and one-line usage

children.title: XYZ Tile Server
children.description: Draw any {z}/{x}/{y} tile server as one XyzRasterTileSource - here OpenStreetMap, with the user agent its tile policy asks for

children.title: WMS
children.description: NASA GIBS true-color imagery of yesterday's Earth over the basemap - one GetMap request per web-mercator tile

children.title: WMTS
children.description: Display a WMTS server as the basemap through its web-mercator tile matrix set

children.title: Vector File Formats
children.description: Open a vector file - a shapefile, GeoJSON, KML, GPX, MapInfo TAB, TinyGeo, CAD, a GeoPDF - or build features in code; reading the format is the only line that differs

children.title: Raster File Formats
children.description: Open a raster file - GeoTIFF, ECW, JPEG 2000, MrSID or anything else GDAL reads - through the classic source named after the format, warped to Web Mercator once and served as tiles

children.title: Databases
children.description: Open a table from a database - SQLite, a GeoPackage, an Esri file geodatabase, PostgreSQL / PostGIS or SQL Server; the connection is the only line that differs

children.title: Offline Tiles
children.description: Serve tiles off disk with no network - an MBTiles or PMTiles archive, vector or raster, or a folder of z/x/y images written by QGIS; opening the archive is the only line that differs

children.title: Nautical Charts
children.description: Draw an S-57 chart with its embedded S-52 styling, and ask it at every step of a ship's route about the depth under her keel, the aids to navigation and hazards nearby, and the restricted areas she is in

children.title: Render Points, Lines and Polygons
children.description: Style points, lines and polygons and label each of them - the style document sits beside the map, editable while it runs

children.title: Render Based on Rules
children.description: One dataset, four expressions: match, step, filter and case - the ValueStyle, ClassBreakStyle, FilterStyle and boolean-expression styles as one mechanism, editable while the map runs

children.title: Advanced Labels
children.description: Six label lessons on crafted data: text bends along its line, anchors from its own column, yields to priority, wraps and recases, keeps its icon when crowded, and writes CJK vertically - each document editable while it runs

children.title: Render Based on Code
children.description: Two things a style document cannot hold: the clock - day and night sweep the world's capitals with nothing rebuilt - and a paint lambda that reads each state's density into a choropleth ramp, inserted under the basemap's roads and labels

children.title: Display Cluster Points
children.description: Cluster points into markers recomputed for the view - clusters you can click, instead of clusters drawn into a tile

children.title: Display Dot Density
children.description: Two colors of dot mixed inside each state - countable, and a composition a heatmap cannot show - with the dots generated once as data

children.title: Heatmap
children.description: Render point observations as a heatmap, with radius, intensity, opacity and color ramp on live controls

children.title: Isolines
children.description: Generate and label isolines (contour lines) from scattered point values, the field and the contours redrawn every frame

children.title: Hatch Styles
children.description: Fill areas with the classic GeoHatchStyle patterns - each one stroked into an image, registered through style.Images, and named by fill-pattern

children.title: Create a Multi-Column Text Style
children.description: Build a label out of several columns - a concat expression in text-field, where the classic TextStyle used a {COLUMN} template; the document sits beside the map, editable while it runs

children.title: Style Layer Toggles
children.description: Turn individual style.json layers on and off while the map is live

children.title: Insert a Layer Under the Labels
children.description: Aerial imagery under vector streets and labels, with a translucent wash inserted above the roads and below the labels - a slot no overlay can reach, because an overlay is always above everything

children.title: Live Flights
children.description: Every airborne aircraft, live from OpenSky, dead-reckoned forward through one DynamicSource - ten thousand moving markers, one SetPoint per aircraft per tick

children.title: Wind as a Vector Field
children.description: The NDFD wind forecast through a VectorFieldSource: 65k tracer particles advected and faded every frame - the streaming weather-map look - or magnitude-scaled arrows from the same source

children.title: NEXRAD Weather Radar
children.description: One georeferenced PNG draped over the basemap as a GeoImageRasterTileSource - no tile protocol - with the last half hour animating through the source object

children.title: Animate a Weather Grid
children.description: Animate an NDFD sky grid over the basemap - color ramps, resampling and projection

children.title: Dynamic Rendering
children.description: A century of state populations as animated circles: size and tint are data, the circle is one registered disc image drawn at every point, and a year change is one SetPoint per state

children.title: Vehicle Navigation
children.description: Navigate to the Empire State Building using GPS points (vehicle tracking)

children.title: Perspective Tilt
children.description: Tilt the camera over vector tiles or over a raster basemap - the gestures are built into the MapView

children.title: 3D Buildings
children.description: Extrude building footprints and move the camera around them

children.title: 3D Terrain
children.description: Drape the map over elevation data

children.title: Lane-Level Navigation
children.description: In-car view over an OpenDRIVE HD map: every lane as surveyed with its paint, a follow camera the engine flies, the vehicle in the style's marker batch, 3D buildings in front of the road

children.title: Markers
children.description: Add, drag and remove markers on the map with the MarkerOverlay - and tilt the map, the markers keep their ground position

children.title: Animated Marker
children.description: A marker whose content is your own WPF control - here an animated icon

children.title: Popups
children.description: Add, edit, or remove popups on the map using the PopupOverlay

children.title: Map Navigation
children.description: Zoom, pan, and rotate the map control

children.title: Zoom to the Black Hole

children.title: Zoom to Extents
children.description: Set the map extent in a variety of different ways

children.title: Restrict Map Extent
children.description: Restrict the map's panning area and zoom range using RestrictExtent, MaximumScale, and MinimumScale

children.title: Resize the Map
children.description: Resize the map while preserving the world extent with various map resize modes

children.title: Overview Map
children.description: Overview map with rotating frame; drag to recenter the main map

children.title: Cross the Dateline
children.description: A flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai over the antimeridian: route, corridor and aircraft stored with continuous longitudes, whole on the globe and whole on both sides of the seam in Web Mercator

children.title: Map Tool Controls
children.description: Manage several built-in map tools (logo, mouse coordinates, scaleLine, and the PanZoomBar) from a single sample

children.title: Drag/Resize Adornments
children.description: Toggle drag and resize behavior for multiple adornments

children.title: Legend
children.description: Build a legend whose swatches are the styles the map draws with

children.title: ScaleLine and ScaleBar
children.description: Render ScaleLine and ScaleBar, and give them the projection that makes the distance they report the real one

children.title: Magnetic North
children.description: Display a compass (north arrow) adornment showing Magnetic North / Grid North / True North

children.title: Display Graticule Lines
children.description: Display graticule lines - a latitude/longitude grid

children.title: Measure Distance and Area
children.description: Measure distance and area on the map with the overlay that annotates as you draw

children.title: Edit Features
children.description: Draw, edit, or delete shapes

children.title: Edit Features with Snapping
children.description: Drag a vertex into a circle, and it will snap to its center

children.title: Edit with Constraints
children.description: Enforce minimum vertex spacing, keep a rectangle rectangular, type exact coordinates

children.title: Edit Map Events
children.description: Recognize map editing events

children.title: Get Data from One Feature
children.description: Get data from a feature in a ShapeFile

children.title: Find Features by Spatial Relation
children.description: Query features by spatial relation - containing, crossing, disjoint, intersecting, overlapping, touching, within a shape, or within a distance

children.title: Shape Operations
children.description: Transform a shape - union, buffer, simplify, rotate, scale, translate, convex hull, envelope, intersection or difference - each one a single call on the shape

children.title: Shape Measurements
children.description: Measure a shape - area, length, center point, shortest line to somewhere else, or a stretch of a line starting a given distance along

children.title: Validate Topology
children.description: Every rule TopologyValidator checks - what points may touch, what lines may cross, what polygons may leave between them - on shapes small enough to see the answer

children.title: Check if Features are Equal
children.description: Use layer query tools to find which features in a layer are topologically equal to a shape

children.title: Project Features
children.description: Projected when the data is READ (CPU) - every vertex through proj4 as it comes off disk

children.title: Project a Raster
children.description: Projected when the data is READ (CPU) - a raster has no vertices, so it is resampled pixel by pixel

children.title: Setting the Projection of a Layer
children.description: Projected when the data is READ (CPU) - the converter lives on the layer, so every fetch comes back projected

children.title: Reproject a Raster Tile Service
children.description: Projected when the data is READ (CPU) - a tile service warped between EPSG:3857 and EPSG:4326, the warped tiles cached in their own second cache

children.title: Any Projection, Vector Tiles
children.description: Projected when the map is DRAWN - a full map, zoom and pan and style, in any proj4 definition, from the same web-mercator tiles, and animated from one projection to the next

children.title: Any Projection, Satellite Imagery (ThinkGeo Cloud)
children.description: Projected when the map is drawn - satellite tiles warped per vertex, with no CPU resampling

children.title: The Globe
children.description: Projected when the map is drawn - the same tiles on a sphere, and what it does when you zoom in far enough to let go

children.title: CPU vs GPU projection, side by side
children.description: Both routes at once - the same shapefile projected at READ time on the left and at DRAW time on the right, with what each costs

children.description: Draw your map onto an image file
